stage.note: Fly.io's own posts never label the rounds Series A/B/C explicitly beyond the $12M (Aug 2021, Intel Capital-led) and $25M (closed June 2022, a16z-led) rounds reported by TechCrunch as 'Series A' and 'Series B'. The $70MM EQT Ventures-led round (announced 2023-06-27) is the next priced round after that Series B and is treated here as the de facto Series C/last round; no public round-name confirmation found.

note: Fly.io (maker of 'Sprites') was founded 2017 by Kurt Mackey (previously founder of MongoHQ/Compose, sold to IBM in 2015) and went through Y Combinator Winter 2020. Confirmed rounds: $12M Series A (Aug 2021, led by Intel Capital), $25M Series B (closed June 2022, led by Andreessen Horowitz with Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital, Initialized Capital and Sam Lambert), and $70M (announced June 2023, led by EQT Ventures) — total $107M confirmed. No later financing round, acquisition, or revenue/ARR disclosure was found as of 2026-09-30; company remains independent and privately held.
